description: The empty group, and the non-equivalence the Q7 ruling creates. everyInstance over a group with no live instance is FALSE by decision (ADR-42), so q_gate_c stays hidden; not(anyInstance(not answered)) over the SAME empty group is TRUE, so q_gate_d shows. The two would be the same rule under vacuous truth, and this scenario is what stops either being implemented as a rewrite of the other. Amended under Q30 (Code Owner, 2026-10-03, the second recorded exception in CORPUS.md): `stp_pax` holds a repeating group, so it is a visible step and the current step even with an empty roster, and it contributes one view with a null instance. The non-equivalence this scenario exists to pin is in `visible` and is untouched.
